title: Topic 11: Shopping - Vocabulary
description: Core words for shopping: shop, market, open, closed, size, bag, card, cash. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Buy things, ask prices, sizes, quantities
introductionText:
shop = you buy things there  |  market = a big open shop,
many small shops in one place
open = you can go in :)  |  closed = you cannot go in
size = small or big  |  bag = you put things in it
card = plastic money  |  cash = paper money
+ phrase bank: Can I help you? | Card or cash? |
this bag (here) / that bag (there)
+ grammar note: THIS/THAT + one thing;
THESE/THOSE + 2, 3, 4... things

vocabularyBlocks.title: Shopping words
exampleSentences: Can I have this one, please?
Can you buy apples for me?

grammarBlocks.title: THIS / THAT / THESE / THOSE (G4) + CAN I...? / CAN YOU...? p
grammarBlocks.explanation: THIS / THAT / THESE / THOSE (G4) + CAN I...? / CAN YOU...? polite requests (G11) + How much recycled from T9

questions.question: It is Sunday. The shop is not open. It is ___.
Paper money in your hand is ___.
Tap the missing word: My apples, my bread and my rice are in one big ___.
Tap the missing word: There are many small shops with food at the ___.
Which word is NOT about shopping?
Shop assistant: Good morning! Can I help you? You: ___
options: Yes, please. How much is this bag?
I get up in the morning
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, please. How much is this bag?

questions.question: Grammar: ___ bag here is cheap. ___ bags there are expensive!
Grammar: ___ I have this small bag, please? And ___ you open it?

explanations.A1-T11-VOC-Q1: Closed = you cannot go in. Open = come in!
explanations.A1-T11-VOC-Q3: A bag = you put your things in it.
explanations.A1-T11-VOC-Q4: Market = a big place with many small shops.
explanations.A1-T11-VOC-Q5: Bedroom is a room at home (Topic 6).
explanations.A1-T11-VOC-Q6: Can I help you? -> ask about the thing you want.
explanations.A1-T11-VOC-Q7: THIS + one, near. THOSE + many, there.
explanations.A1-T11-VOC-Q8: Requests: Can I have...? Can you open...? + please!
